children: Overview
U.S. optical networking supplier's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 37% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q3 rose 215% to $2.11
Company repurchased $171.7 mln in shares during the quarter
Outlook
Ciena sees Q4 revenue at $1.75 bln plus or minus $50 mln
Company raises full-year revenue guidance to $6.42 bln plus or minus $50 mln
Ciena expects Q4 adjusted gross margin of 45% plus or minus 50 bps
Result Drivers
AI-DRIVEN NETWORK INVESTMENT - Co said increased demand for high-speed connectivity solutions, as AI drives greater network investment, boosted results
SUPPLY CAPACITY - Expanding supply capacity supported profitability, per CFO Marc Graff
OPTICAL NETWORKING SEGMENT - Most revenue growth came from optical networking segment
